sections.title: Ack Reply
sections.summary: Ack legality, ack-state persistence, and delegated reply delivery.
sections.commentary: This machine validates the ack target, commits the ack transition first, then builds one reply delivery request and delegates the outward reply path to the approved new-message machine instead of embedding reply logic back into `ack`.

sections.title: Delivery Policy Coordinator
sections.summary: Central dispatcher for write-affecting mail events.
sections.commentary: This coordinator resolves event family and canonical roster harness, then dispatches into the required event-family state machine without letting command-local conditionals own delivery policy.

sections.title: Inbox Repair
sections.summary: Explicit staged rebuild for a Claude inbox repair request.
sections.commentary: This machine is the approved bulk mailbox creation or rebuild path. It validates Claude harness ownership, loads a bounded repair projection, filters deleted messages, stages the rebuild, and publishes atomically.

sections.title: Claude Harness New Message
sections.summary: New-message state machine for Claude Code harness delivery.
sections.commentary: This machine persists SQLite first on the success path, allows Claude-only compatibility append after commit, and on SQLite failure still emits the original plus an `atm-system@<team>` error companion with mirrored nudges.
notes: sqlite failure emits original + error companion
append failure after sqlite success falls back to post-send-hook

sections.title: Non-Claude Harness New Message
sections.summary: New-message state machine for non-Claude harness delivery.
sections.commentary: This machine never appends JSONL. It persists SQLite on the success path, routes the original message through the non-Claude delivery path, and on SQLite failure still emits the original plus an `atm-system@<team>` error companion through that same non-Claude path.
notes: sqlite failure emits original + error companion

sections.title: Restore Inbox Rebuild
sections.summary: Restore-marker-scoped staged publish for inbox restore recovery.
sections.commentary: This machine stays distinct from normal repair because it is a privileged recovery path with restore-marker validation, staged restore output, and restore-specific publish semantics.

sections.title: Thread Update
sections.summary: Add-details and supersede legality plus harness-dispatched delivery.
sections.commentary: This machine is distinct from new-message delivery because it must prove parent existence, root existence, original-sender identity, and one-successor linearity before persisting or dispatching any outward effect.
